svg.title: Crypto strength map, November 2026
svg.desc: Scores from 1 (weak) to 5 (strong) for 17 networks on nine factors, sorted by the long-term score. Data in crypto-strength/data/scores.csv.
svg.text: Sorted by long-term score. Scored 2026-11-01. Educational only, not investment advice.

g.title: ETH Decentral.: 4/5. Large validator set and several client teams; Lido holds 24.45% of stake [S05, J]
ETH Security: 5/5. No chain halt since 2015; survived the PoW-to-PoS switch [J]
ETH Scalability: 3/5. L1 stays narrow; capacity comes from rollups that post data to Ethereum [S15, J]
ETH Afford.: 3/5. Solo staking needs 32 ETH (about $72k at $2261); node needs a large SSD [S12, J]
ETH Adoption: 5/5. Market-cap rank 2; most developers of any ecosystem (6244 monthly active) [S12, S11]
ETH Maturity: 5/5. Mainnet since 2015 [J]
ETH Fees solved: 4/5. EIP-1559 fee market plus rollups give cent-level fees on L2; L1 is still costly at peaks [J]
ETH Privacy: 1/5. Transparent by default; privacy only at the application layer [J]

ETH Crypto force: 4/5. Funded post-quantum team, weekly PQ devnets with 10+ clients, ~2029 target, ~0.1% of ETH in vulnerable dormant accounts; MEV and app-level contract exploits remain the main risk [S06, J]
ETH long-term score 4.20 (weighted mean)
BTC Decentral.: 4/5. Anyone can validate on consumer hardware; but Foundry (~30%) and AntPool (~19%) mine over half the blocks and six pools mine >95% [S04, J]
BTC Security: 5/5. Longest record of any chain; no consensus failure in over a decade; largest hashrate to attack [J]
BTC Scalability: 2/5. About 7 tx/s on L1; Lightning adds capacity but is not used by most holders [J]
BTC Afford.: 4/5. A full node runs on a small consumer machine; mining needs ASICs and cheap power [J]
BTC Adoption: 5/5. Market-cap rank 1; about 1200 monthly active developers [S12, S11]
BTC Maturity: 5/5. Mainnet since 2009 [J]
BTC Fees solved: 2/5. Fee market spikes under demand; Lightning helps only for small payments [J]
BTC Privacy: 1/5. Transparent ledger; privacy only by user discipline (coinjoin) [J]

BTC Crypto force: 3/5. Costliest chain to 51%-attack and small attack surface (no general smart contracts); but ~6.51M BTC have exposed public keys and BIP-360 has no activation path yet; pool concentration [S07, S04]
BTC long-term score 3.84 (weighted mean)
DOT Decentral.: 5/5. Highest Nakamoto coefficient measured (179) over 600 validators [S02]
DOT Security: 4/5. Shared security for parachains; no long halts known [J]
DOT Scalability: 4/5. Parallel parachains with async backing [J]
DOT Afford.: 3/5. Active validator set has a high effective minimum stake [J]
DOT Adoption: 3/5. Third-most developers (1245 monthly active) but market cap below rank 41 [S11, S12]
DOT Maturity: 3/5. Relay chain since 2020 [J]
DOT Fees solved: 4/5. Low, weight-based fees [J]
DOT Privacy: 1/5. Transparent by default [J]
DOT Crypto force: 4/5. Very high Nakamoto coefficient and fast forkless upgrades; no PQ migration yet [S02, J]
DOT long-term score 3.72 (weighted mean)
ALGO Decentral.: 3/5. Nakamoto coefficient 14 over 1573 validators [S02, S01]
ALGO Security: 4/5. Instant finality; no long halts known [J]
ALGO Scalability: 4/5. Seconds-level blocks with instant finality [J]
ALGO Afford.: 4/5. No minimum stake to participate; modest hardware [J]
ALGO Adoption: 2/5. Market cap below rank 41 [S12]
ALGO Maturity: 4/5. Mainnet since 2019 [J]
ALGO Fees solved: 5/5. Fixed minimum fee of 0.001 ALGO [J]
ALGO Privacy: 1/5. Transparent by default [J]
ALGO Crypto force: 4/5. Already uses post-quantum Falcon signatures in state proofs, closest to production PQ among major chains [S07]
ALGO long-term score 3.56 (weighted mean)
XRP Decentral.: 2/5. Validators trust a Unique Node List that most operators take from one published list [S16, J]
XRP Security: 3/5. About 64-minute halt in Feb 2025 when validations stopped publishing [S16]
XRP Scalability: 4/5. Seconds-level finality and high throughput for payments [J]
XRP Afford.: 3/5. No stake needed to run a validator, but UNL inclusion is gated [J]
XRP Adoption: 4/5. Market-cap rank 5 [S12]
XRP Maturity: 5/5. Mainnet since 2012 [J]
XRP Fees solved: 5/5. Tiny fixed fees that burn XRP [J]
XRP Privacy: 1/5. Transparent by default [J]
XRP Crypto force: 2/5. Liveness depends on a small trusted list; no PQ plan known [S16, J]
XRP long-term score 3.28 (weighted mean)
AVAX Decentral.: 3/5. Nakamoto coefficient 25 (Chainspect) or 22 (Nakaflow) over 563 validators [S02, S01]
AVAX Security: 4/5. Short stalls but no long halts known [J]
AVAX Scalability: 4/5. Sub-second finality; app-specific L1s add capacity [J]
AVAX Afford.: 3/5. 2000 AVAX minimum stake (about $17k at $8.66) [S12, J]
AVAX Adoption: 3/5. Market-cap rank 29 [S12]
AVAX Maturity: 3/5. Mainnet since 2020 [J]
AVAX Fees solved: 4/5. Low fees with dynamic base fee [J]
AVAX Privacy: 1/5. Transparent by default [J]
AVAX Crypto force: 3/5. Medium Nakamoto coefficient; bridge risk on cross-chain assets; no PQ plan known [S02, J]
AVAX long-term score 3.24 (weighted mean)
LTC Decentral.: 3/5. Merged-mined with Dogecoin by a few large pools [J]
LTC Security: 4/5. No successful attack on the main chain known [J]
LTC Scalability: 2/5. Bitcoin-like L1 with faster blocks [J]
LTC Afford.: 4/5. Full node on consumer hardware [J]
LTC Adoption: 3/5. Market-cap rank 26; common payment option [S12, J]
LTC Maturity: 5/5. Mainnet since 2011 [J]
LTC Fees solved: 3/5. Low fees, as demand is low [J]
LTC Privacy: 2/5. Optional MWEB extension blocks [J]
LTC Crypto force: 2/5. Far less hashrate than Bitcoin; no PQ plan known [J]
LTC long-term score 3.24 (weighted mean)
ADA Decentral.: 4/5. Nakamoto coefficient 15 over 2069 stake pools; pools run on modest hardware [S02]
ADA Security: 4/5. 21 Nov 2025 malformed transaction split the chain for up to 14 h; block production did not stop [S10]
ADA Scalability: 2/5. Low L1 throughput; Hydra and sidechains are early [J]
ADA Afford.: 4/5. No minimum stake to run a pool; modest hardware [J]
ADA Adoption: 2/5. Market-cap rank 18; small developer base relative to its rank [S12, J]
ADA Maturity: 4/5. Mainnet since 2017 [J]
ADA Fees solved: 3/5. Predictable, low fees, but congestion at peaks [J]
ADA Privacy: 1/5. Transparent by default (privacy planned in a separate chain, Midnight) [J]
ADA Crypto force: 3/5. Broad stake distribution; formal-methods culture; no PQ migration yet [S02, J]
ADA long-term score 3.24 (weighted mean)
NEAR Decentral.: 2/5. Nakamoto coefficient 9 over 379 validators [S02, S01]
NEAR Security: 4/5. No long halts known [J]
NEAR Scalability: 4/5. Sharded design (Nightshade) [J]
NEAR Afford.: 3/5. Seat price set by stake auction [J]
NEAR Adoption: 3/5. Market-cap rank 21 [S12]
NEAR Maturity: 3/5. Mainnet since 2020 [J]
NEAR Fees solved: 5/5. Very low fees on a sharded chain [J]
NEAR Privacy: 1/5. Transparent by default [J]
NEAR Crypto force: 3/5. Low Nakamoto coefficient; no PQ migration yet [S02, J]
NEAR long-term score 3.16 (weighted mean)
SOL Decentral.: 3/5. Nakamoto coefficient 17 (Chainspect) or 6 (Nakaflow) over 665 validators; heavy hardware concentrates validators in data centres [S02, S01]
SOL Security: 3/5. Several full outages up to Feb 2024; no full outage since; Aug 2026 routing failure took 28.83% of stake offline without a halt [S17]
SOL Scalability: 5/5. About 1000 tx/s sustained, 11015 tx/s peak, 400 ms finality [S03]
SOL Afford.: 2/5. Validators need data-centre hardware and pay vote fees [J]
SOL Adoption: 4/5. Market-cap rank 7; second-most developers (3201 monthly active) [S12, S11]
SOL Maturity: 3/5. Mainnet since 2020 [J]
SOL Fees solved: 5/5. Sub-cent fees with local fee markets at high throughput [S03, J]
SOL Privacy: 1/5. Transparent by default [J]
SOL Crypto force: 2/5. No public post-quantum roadmap; low Nakamoto coefficient by one measure; outage history [S07, S01, S17]
SOL long-term score 3.16 (weighted mean)
XMR Decentral.: 3/5. CPU mining (RandomX) is open to anyone, but Qubic reached about 22% average hashrate [S08]
XMR Security: 2/5. 18-block reorg on 14-15 Sep 2025 invalidated 118 transactions [S09]
XMR Scalability: 2/5. Large private transactions limit throughput [J]
XMR Afford.: 5/5. Mine and run a node on an ordinary CPU [S08, J]
XMR Adoption: 3/5. Market-cap rank 13; delisted from many exchanges [S12, J]
XMR Maturity: 5/5. Mainnet since 2014 [J]
XMR Fees solved: 3/5. Low fees, as demand is low [J]
XMR Privacy: 5/5. Private by default (ring signatures, stealth addresses, RingCT) [J]
XMR Crypto force: 2/5. Selfish-mining campaign showed a small hashrate market can be rented or bribed; no PQ plan known [S08, S09]
XMR long-term score 3.08 (weighted mean)
ZEC Decentral.: 2/5. ASIC mining concentrated in a few pools [J]
ZEC Security: 3/5. Orchard counterfeiting bug existed 2022-2026; pool halted and patched; no evidence of exploit [S14]
ZEC Scalability: 2/5. Bitcoin-like L1 [J]
ZEC Afford.: 4/5. Full node (Zebra) on consumer hardware [J]
ZEC Adoption: 3/5. Market-cap rank 11 [S12]
ZEC Maturity: 4/5. Mainnet since 2016 [J]
ZEC Fees solved: 4/5. Low fixed-style fees [J]
ZEC Privacy: 4/5. Strong zero-knowledge privacy, but optional; about 30% of supply shielded [S13]
ZEC Crypto force: 3/5. Halo 2 needs no trusted setup; a 4-year latent bug shows the cost of complex cryptography [S14, J]
ZEC long-term score 3.08 (weighted mean)
ARB Decentral.: 1/5. One centralized sequencer [S15]
ARB Security: 4/5. Stage 1: users can force-include via L1 within a day and exit; BoLD fraud proofs [S15]
ARB Scalability: 4/5. Rollup capacity on top of Ethereum [S15, J]
ARB Afford.: 3/5. Anyone can run a node or a validator for fraud proofs; nobody else can sequence [S15]
ARB Adoption: 3/5. About $9.67B secured; 975 monthly developers [S15, S11]
ARB Maturity: 3/5. Mainnet since 2021 [J]
ARB Fees solved: 5/5. Cent-level fees with Ethereum security [J]
ARB Privacy: 1/5. Transparent by default [J]
ARB Crypto force: 3/5. Inherits Ethereum security, but emergency upgrades have no exit window [S15]
ARB long-term score 3.00 (weighted mean)
BNB Decentral.: 2/5. Small validator set; Nakamoto coefficient 7 [S01, J]
BNB Security: 3/5. Chain halted after the 2022 bridge exploit [J]
BNB Scalability: 4/5. About 184 tx/s sustained, 3252 tx/s peak, 650 ms finality [S03]
BNB Afford.: 2/5. Validator seats are few and need large stake [J]
BNB Adoption: 4/5. Market-cap rank 4 [S12]
BNB Maturity: 3/5. Mainnet since 2020 [J]
BNB Fees solved: 4/5. Low fees at moderate throughput [S03, J]
BNB Privacy: 1/5. Transparent by default [J]
BNB Crypto force: 2/5. Small validator set can be coerced; bridge history; no PQ plan known [S01, J]
BNB long-term score 2.84 (weighted mean)
TRX Decentral.: 2/5. 27 super representatives; Nakamoto coefficient 14 [S02]
TRX Security: 3/5. No large halts known, but few block producers [J]
TRX Scalability: 3/5. About 137 tx/s sustained, 439 tx/s peak, 57 s finality [S03]
TRX Afford.: 2/5. Block producers are voted in; fees need staked energy to be cheap [J]
TRX Adoption: 4/5. Market-cap rank 8; large stablecoin transfer volume [S12, J]
TRX Maturity: 4/5. Mainnet since 2018 [J]
TRX Fees solved: 3/5. Cheap with staked energy; a plain stablecoin transfer without it costs about a dollar [J]
TRX Privacy: 1/5. Transparent by default [J]
TRX Crypto force: 2/5. 27 producers are a small target for coercion; no PQ plan known [S02, J]
TRX long-term score 2.84 (weighted mean)
SUI Decentral.: 3/5. Nakamoto coefficient 18 (Chainspect) or 17 (Nakaflow), but only 125 validators [S02, S01]
SUI Security: 3/5. Validators froze stolen funds after the 2025 Cetus exploit, which shows they can coordinate to censor [J]
SUI Scalability: 5/5. About 105 tx/s sustained, 1204 tx/s peak, near-instant finality for owned objects [S03]
SUI Afford.: 2/5. Large minimum stake for a validator [J]
SUI Adoption: 3/5. Market-cap rank 30 [S12]
SUI Maturity: 1/5. Mainnet since 2023 [J]
SUI Fees solved: 5/5. Very low fees [J]
SUI Privacy: 1/5. Transparent by default [J]
SUI Crypto force: 2/5. Small validator set showed it can freeze funds; no PQ plan known [J]
SUI long-term score 2.72 (weighted mean)
ATOM Decentral.: 2/5. Nakamoto coefficient 4 [S01]
ATOM Security: 3/5. No long halts known on the Hub; app-chains vary [J]
ATOM Scalability: 3/5. Scales by many sovereign chains joined by IBC [J]
ATOM Afford.: 3/5. Active set of about 180 validators; entry needs large stake [J]
ATOM Adoption: 2/5. About 1200 monthly developers across Cosmos, but the Hub token is below rank 41 [S11, S12]
ATOM Maturity: 4/5. Hub since 2019 [J]
ATOM Fees solved: 4/5. Low fees [J]
ATOM Privacy: 1/5. Transparent by default [J]
ATOM Crypto force: 2/5. Nakamoto coefficient 4 means few entities can halt the Hub [S01]
ATOM long-term score 2.72 (weighted mean)

svg.text: dashed = author judgment, no opened source
* mainnet younger than 5 years: excluded from the long-term top 10. Hover a cell for its evidence.
